scripts.start: npm run prepare:public-config && ng serve borrower --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4200
scripts.start:borrower: npm run prepare:public-config && ng serve borrower --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4200
scripts.start:admin: npm run prepare:public-config && ng serve admin --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4201
scripts.start:borrower:api: npm run prepare:public-config && ng serve borrower --configuration api --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4200
scripts.start:admin:api: npm run prepare:public-config && ng serve admin --configuration api --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4201
scripts.build: npm run build:borrower && npm run build:admin
scripts.build:borrower: npm run prepare:public-config && ng build borrower
scripts.build:admin: npm run prepare:public-config && ng build admin
scripts.watch: npm run prepare:public-config && ng build borrower --watch --configuration development
scripts.test: npm run test:borrower && npm run test:admin
